result:
I’d make curiosity stronger than contempt.

Most cruelty begins with a refusal to imagine another person’s perspective. If disagreement started with “tell me how you see it” instead of “you’re wrong,” there would still be conflicts—but fewer wars, less needless suffering, and a little less loneliness everywhere.
